derived.description: Seeded ten-region smoke subset, nested in source track.
Seeded ten-region smoke subset, nested in source track.
All 52 French/Finnish/Swedish regions, not balanced, not mixed-language units; report each source separately.

limitations: Three additional principal-language tracks only: French, Finnish and Swedish; no English/German samples repeated from v1.0.0.
All samples are published GT regions, not full pages. Source PAGE line text is stripped at line ends and joined with LF by the existing converter; word-level text is not used.
No independent local re-transcription or damage/illegibility review: all damage and language-mix status remain unannotated. No diplomatic-v1 compliance is asserted for inherited source conventions.
Only bounded validation archives used: no per-language standard-1000 or extended-10000 tier, no full-page tier, no verified mixed-language samples.
All samples are public-eval; publisher validation labels do not mean unseen model tests. No model-training overlap guarantee.
